summary: Pulmatrix, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the closing of a private placement of Series B Convertible Preferred Stock with an affiliate of Eos SENOLYTIX, Inc., which the press release states is part of a planned merger. The Series B Preferred Stock converts into common stock at $2.20 per share, with gross proceeds of approximately $1 million. The issuance was exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506 of Regulation D. The filing indicates an ongoing merger process with Eos as the acquirer. Investors should watch for the definitive merger agreement and regulatory approvals to assess the risk-arb spread and timeline.
